note: Operated by Augusta-Richmond County in 286-acre Diamond Lakes Regional Park, on the old Augusta International Speedway site. The park has 5 fishing ponds (Georgia fishing license; no swimming, no motorized boats or trolling motors); Spirit Creek along the south border. --Claude
